milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate into the decorative building (12+ blocks from spawn) and observe the jungle stairs. max_distance=5 requires actual navigation since the building entrance is at Z=12. facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking at the stairs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must climb the jungle stairs to the upper floor and observe the magenta stained glass windows at the back wall. Being within 5 blocks at Y=4 elevation confirms the player reached the upper floor via the stairs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate west to the nature exhibit (12 blocks from spawn) and observe the potted oxeye daisy on its pedestal. max_distance=5 requires genuine navigation to the exhibit area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate to the aquarium section adjacent to the nature exhibit and observe the brain coral block inside the glass enclosure. The coral is kept alive by water placed above it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must traverse into the elevated color corridor (only accessible from the upper floor doorway) and approach the magenta concrete powder blocks. Being within 5 blocks at corridor elevation (Y~4) confirms navigation through the upper floor into the corridor.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must continue through the color corridor past the magenta concrete powder to reach the pink wool blocks at the far end. Being within 5 blocks confirms full corridor traversal.

Uses position_near_with_facing (max_distance=3) combined with inventory_has because the player must climb to the upper floor and approach the anvil at (0,4,17) with the iron hoe. The tight spatial requirement (3 blocks from upper-floor anvil) ensures meaningful stair navigation occurred. While this is a proxy (cannot verify rename action directly), reaching the anvil with the tool is the prerequisite for renaming.

Uses inventory_has combined with position_near_with_facing because the player must traverse the entire corridor, break the placed shulker box to pick it up, and be near the corridor-end anvil at (14,4,18). Having shulker_box in inventory (it starts as a placed block, not in inventory) proves the player broke it, and being within 3 blocks of the corridor-end anvil proves full traversal.

Uses inventory_has because polished diorite drops itself when mined with a pickaxe. The player does not start with polished_diorite in inventory, so any amount confirms mining the barrier wall in the mine shaft occurred.

Uses inventory_has because chiseled nether bricks drop themselves when mined with a pickaxe. The player does not start with this item, and the nether brick barrier is only reachable after mining through the diorite barrier first.

Uses inventory_has because when the player crafts an iron block (9 iron ingots from the chest behind the diorite barrier in a 3x3 grid), the resulting iron block appears in inventory. The player does not start with iron_block, so its presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because when the player crafts a gold block (9 gold ingots from the chest behind the nether brick barrier in a 3x3 grid), the resulting gold block appears in inventory. The player does not start with gold_block, so its presence confirms successful crafting.
